Beginner’s Guide: How to Buy Products From China With Hiobuy

Hiobuy allows you to purchase products from supported Chinese shopping platforms and ship them to your country.

The process is divided into two main stages: purchasing the products and arranging international shipping.

Step 1: Create an Account

Register a Hiobuy account and complete the required account information.

Make sure your email address and contact details are correct so that you can receive order and parcel notifications.

Step 2: Find a Product

You can search for products on the website or paste a supported product link into the search bar.

Select the correct:

  • Color
  • Size
  • Model
  • Quantity
  • Product specification

Review the product details carefully before submitting the order.

Step 3: Pay for the Product

The first payment usually covers the product cost, domestic delivery and applicable service fees.

After payment, the purchasing team will process your order.

Step 4: Wait for Warehouse Arrival

The Chinese seller will send the product to the Hiobuy warehouse.

After arrival, the warehouse will register the item and may provide inspection photos.

Step 5: Submit an International Parcel

Select the stored products you want to ship together.

Enter your delivery address, choose a shipping route and select any packaging services.

Step 6: Pay International Shipping

After the parcel is packed and measured, pay the international shipping fee.

Step 7: Track Your Parcel

Once shipped, you can check the tracking number and logistics updates from your account.
